description: This file defines the AwsException class within the Aws\Exception namespace. The class represents an exception thrown by AWS SDK commands, providing access to related request, response, error details, and monitoring information. It includes various methods for retrieving error attributes and managing transfer info.

classes.name: AwsException
classes.description: Represents an AWS SDK exception that is thrown when a command encounters an error. Provides methods to access error details, request/response objects, and manage transfer info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with message, command, context, and previous exception, setting relevant properties.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, including inner exception details if any.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command object associated with the exception.

methods.name: getAwsErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the specific AWS error message if available.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request object associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response object associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the result object related to the exception, if available.

methods.name: isConnectionError
methods.description: Indicates whether the exception was caused by a connection error.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code from the response, if available.

methods.name: getAwsRequestId
methods.description: Returns the AWS request ID associated with the error.

methods.name: getAwsErrorType
methods.description: Returns the AWS error type.

methods.name: getAwsErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the AWS error code.

methods.name: getAwsErrorShape
methods.description: Returns the error shape details if available.

methods.name: getTransferInfo
methods.description: Provides transfer statistics related to the exception, or the entire transfer info if no argument is given.

methods.name: setTransferInfo
methods.description: Replaces the transfer information with provided array.

methods.name: isMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the maximum retries threshold has been exceeded.

methods.name: setMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Sets the max retries exceeded flag.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if the specified key exists in the data array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the exception's data by key.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search on the exception data.
